description: Prepare settlement statements, balance the file, and disburse buyer, lender, payoff, and seller funds from the title escrow trust accounts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 34 closings and 140 outgoing wires per business day (about $14.4 million); lender funding deadlines and rate locks; buyers moving in; trust funds may be used only per closing instructions
manual_workaround: Reschedule closings not yet funded; for funded files, release wires through the bank portal from a printed, dual-signed disbursement worksheet built from the last ledger export; no new payees without callback
dependent_systems: SYS-02; SYS-03; SYS-04; SYS-05 (portal); SYS-06; SYS-07; SYS-09
dependent_third_parties: Title production software vendor; 2 trust account banks; lenders; title insurance underwriter
dependent_people_or_facilities: 112 Title and Closing staff; closing rooms at headquarters and 8 offices
quantified_operational_impact: About 34 closings per day; after 8 hours about 34 closings slip to the next day
quantified_regulatory_impact: Trust fund records must stay accurate (Fla. Stat. 626.8473(4)-(5)); lender closing instructions; homebuilder closing schedule
funds_at_risk: About $14.4 million disbursed per business day; manual disbursement raises the chance of a fraudulent payee being paid

business_process: Wire instruction delivery and payee verification
description: Deliver wire instructions and closing documents through the Closing Communications Portal; call back verified numbers before any new payee or changed account
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: If the portal is down, buyers and agents fall back to email, which is the channel fraudsters exploit; one diverted buyer wire is $60,000 to $250,000
manual_workaround: Phone-only fallback: the closer calls the buyer at the number verified at contract and reads the instructions; nothing is sent by email; clients are told to call before wiring
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider; contract development firm; text message provider
quantified_operational_impact: About 140 instruction deliveries and 40 callbacks per business day; phone fallback adds about 10 minutes each
quantified_regulatory_impact: A diverted wire can breach trust fund duties (Fla. Stat. 626.8473(4)) and trigger FTC and Florida notice duties if customer information was exposed

description: Order payoff statements, verify them with the lender through its portal or published number, and confirm lien releases after closing
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payoffs are ordered 5 to 10 days before closing; spoofed payoff letters target this step; a payoff wire is $150,000 to $400,000
manual_workaround: Lender payoff portals and published lender phone numbers; payoff processors keep a printed list of verified lender contacts
quantified_regulatory_impact: Trust funds must go only where the instructions direct (Fla. Stat. 626.8473(4))

description: Manage contracts, addenda, contingency deadlines, compliance review, and document storage for every sale
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 50 sides per business day; inspection, financing, and appraisal contingency deadlines run in days; about $232,000 brokerage company dollar per business day
manual_workaround: Agents use the e-signature service directly; coordinators track deadlines from the daily export; compliance review catches up after recovery
quantified_operational_impact: About 50 sides per day; after 24 hours about 6 contingency deadlines need manual follow-up
quantified_regulatory_impact: Broker supervision and document retention for every transaction file
funds_at_risk: Indirect: contract file data is used to build wire instructions

business_process: Earnest money deposit receipt and escrow
description: Receive buyer deposits into the sales escrow account, record them against the transaction, and verify deposits held by others
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 15 deposits per business day; deposits must be placed in escrow by the end of the third business day (r. 61J2-14.008(3)); deposit verification requests within 10 business days (r. 61J2-14.008(2)(b))
manual_workaround: Deposit at a bank branch; paper deposit log signed by the Controller; record in SYS-13 after recovery
quantified_regulatory_impact: A late deposit is a license compliance issue for the Broker of Record
funds_at_risk: About $440,000 per business day in incoming deposits
regulatory_driver: Fla. Admin. Code r. 61J2-14.008; Fla. Stat. 475.25(1)(k)

description: Order searches, examine title, and issue commitments for each closing
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Commitments are due 5 to 15 days before closing, so a 2-day outage can be absorbed
manual_workaround: Underwriter title plant access through the underwriter agent portal; prioritize files closing within 7 days
dependent_third_parties: Title search vendor; title insurance underwriter
quantified_operational_impact: About 40 new title orders per business day

description: Record documents, issue title policies, remit premiums, and track lien releases
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Recording and policy issuance run on weekly cycles; the underwriter agreement sets policy remittance deadlines
manual_workaround: Courier recording; policy issuance from the underwriter portal
dependent_third_parties: E-recording vendor; county recorders; title insurance underwriter
quantified_operational_impact: About 34 recordings per business day queue up

description: Create and update listings, syndicate them to the MLS and websites
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 55 new listings per business day; agents can enter listings directly in the MLS, which is external
manual_workaround: Agents enter listings directly in the MLS; marketing loads them to the company website after recovery
quantified_operational_impact: About 55 listings per day delayed on company sites
quantified_regulatory_impact: Fair Housing Act advertising rules apply to all listing content (42 U.S.C. 3604(c))

description: Route inbound buyer and seller leads, score them, and assign follow-up
process_owner: Director of Inside Sales and Relocation
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 4,800 leads a month; speed of first contact drives conversion; relocation and referral revenue about $16,000 per business day
manual_workaround: Website forms go to a shared mailbox; leads assigned by a manager from a spreadsheet in arrival order
dependent_third_parties: CRM vendor; mortgage joint venture (lead referrals)
quantified_operational_impact: About 220 leads per business day wait for assignment
quantified_regulatory_impact: Lead referrals to the mortgage joint venture need prior consent and an Affiliated Business Arrangement disclosure (12 CFR 1024.15(b)(1))

business_process: Agent onboarding, offboarding, and license compliance
description: Onboard and offboard contractor agents, verify licenses, and grant or remove system access
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 8 agent departures and 7 arrivals per week; delayed offboarding leaves former agents with access to client files
manual_workaround: Managing brokers phone departures to the IT service desk, which disables identities from a printed list; new agents wait
dependent_people_or_facilities: Agent services staff; managing brokers; IT service desk
quantified_operational_impact: About 1 departure per business day must be disabled manually

description: Calculate splits from closing statements and pay agents by ACH
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 50 agent payouts per business day, normally within 2 business days of closing
manual_workaround: Manual commission statements and checks signed by the Controller and the CFO
quantified_operational_impact: About 50 payouts per day delayed; agent complaints and recruiting risk
funds_at_risk: Agent payout bank account changes are a fraud target (gap 2)

description: Collect rents through the tenant portal, apply them, and pay owners by monthly ACH
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $9.6 million of rent a month, most of it paid between the 1st and 5th (about $1.9 million per day in that window); owner distributions by the 10th; about $56,000 property management fees per business day
manual_workaround: Tenants pay through the bank lockbox; owner distributions from the prior month statement by ACH file in the bank portal, with dual approval
dependent_third_parties: Property management platform vendor; payment processor; property management escrow bank
quantified_operational_impact: About 4,800 rent payments a month; a 2-day outage in the first week delays about $3.8 million
quantified_regulatory_impact: Owner agreements set distribution dates; rents and deposits are held in escrow
funds_at_risk: About $1.9 million per day in the rent window; owner payout bank changes are a fraud target (gap 2)

description: Take applications, run screening, decide, and send FCRA adverse action notices
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 60 applications per business day; each day of vacancy costs owners about $65 a home
manual_workaround: Applications held; leasing teams use the screening provider portal directly for urgent files
dependent_third_parties: Tenant screening provider; consumer reporting agencies
quantified_regulatory_impact: FCRA adverse action notices (15 U.S.C. 1681m(a)) and Fair Housing Act duties continue during an outage

description: Receive work orders, dispatch vendors, and handle emergencies (water leaks, no air conditioning, lockouts)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 180 work orders per business day; emergencies need same-day dispatch, and Florida heat makes air conditioning failures urgent
manual_workaround: 24x7 answering service takes calls; coordinators dispatch from a printed vendor list and log work on paper
quantified_operational_impact: About 20 emergency calls per day need dispatch
quantified_regulatory_impact: Landlord repair duties under leases and owner agreements

description: Daily reconciliation of title trust accounts; monthly reconciliations of all escrow and trust accounts, signed by the broker or the President of Title and Closing
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Monthly reconciliation is required for broker escrow accounts (r. 61J2-14.012(2)); daily title reconciliation is the main check that detects a diverted wire
manual_workaround: Bank statements and ledger exports reconciled in spreadsheets
dependent_people_or_facilities: Escrow accounting staff; Title Escrow Accounting Manager
quantified_operational_impact: Daily title reconciliation backlog of about 140 wires per day
quantified_regulatory_impact: Monthly reconciliation and explanation of differences (r. 61J2-14.012(2)-(3))
funds_at_risk: Late reconciliation delays detection of a diverted wire
regulatory_driver: Fla. Admin. Code r. 61J2-14.012; Fla. Stat. 626.8473(5)

description: Employee payroll, HR records, and monthly financial close
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Biweekly payroll; monthly close for the private equity sponsor
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll; delay the close

description: Listing website, leasing website with the leasing assistant chatbot, newsletters
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Listings also appear on MLS-fed portals, so buyers can still find homes
manual_workaround: Static outage page with phone numbers; listings remain on MLS-fed portals
quantified_operational_impact: About 9,000 website sessions a day see an outage page
